description: This file contains PHP scripts that manage parental control services, including adding, editing, and deleting services, handling port testing, time conflict detection, and managing trusted users. It provides backend logic to manipulate configuration data related to network services and parental control settings.

methods.name: PORTTEST
methods.description: Checks if given start and end ports are within or overlapping with specified port ranges.

methods.name: time_date_conflict
methods.description: Detects if two time blocks with days conflict based on overlapping days and times.
